learnings: When a model encounters API errors during file review, the audit tool should implement retry logic before marking files as inconclusive
For trivially safe files (license texts, README files), the audit tool could use pattern matching or caching to avoid unnecessary LLM calls that might fail

When one model has complete coverage and finds no issues, while another model has partial coverage due to infrastructure errors, the complete model's verdict should take precedence rather than defaulting to inconclusive

The disagreement resolution logic should distinguish between substantive security disagreements and infrastructure failures - API errors should not trigger re-audits or override complete safe verdicts
